1.title: Boat That Sank Near Alcatraz Rolled After Wave Struck, Officials Say
1.summary: Rescuers described survivors trying to stay afloat in the San Francisco Bay. A brother of the boat’s owner died, and the authorities say they will end the search for the missing.

2.title: Trump Says He’ll Seek to Replace Immigrant Truck Drivers With Veterans
2.summary: The president has pushed to curtail the commercial licenses of immigrants, including legal residents, whom he has blamed for crashes.

3.title: Investigators Seek Information From Government Officials as Part of Air Force One Leak Investigation
3.summary: After The New York Times reported on security concerns related to the Qatari-donated jet, the F.B.I. sought to speak with several people who flew aboard the plane with President Trump last week and asked for their phones.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Exchange Strikes for Fifth Straight Day
4.summary: Though both sides appeared to be digging in, a top Iranian official seemed to leave the door open for a deal, saying, “We must fear neither war nor negotiations.”

5.title: New monkey species with orange lips found 'hiding' in DRC forest
5.summary: Scientists describe "amazing feeling" to look into the face of an animal that so few people knew existed.

6.title: Families of 43 victims await verdict in Genoa bridge disaster
6.summary: A large section of the giant Morandi motorway bridge crumbled and collapsed on to the railway tracks below.
